test_cases.title: Treatment received outside Ireland is recommended for decline
preconditions: A member and claim are available for assessment.
The claim is for treatment received outside Ireland that would otherwise be covered.
steps: Submit the claim for assessment.
Check the claim's routing outcome and reason code.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code EXCLUDED.

test_cases.title: Excluded treatment outcome is independent of claim amount and membership duration
preconditions: Claims are available for assessment for a cosmetic procedure.
Test members have short and long membership durations.
steps: Submit claims covering the combinations of low and high claim amounts with short and long membership durations.
Check the routing outcome and reason code for each claim.
test_cases.expected_result: Every claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code EXCLUDED, regardless of amount or membership duration.

test_cases.title: Receipt containing excluded and covered items is routed to manual review
preconditions: A member and claim are available for assessment.
The receipt contains both an excluded item and a covered item.
steps: Submit the claim with the combined receipt for assessment.
Check the claim's routing outcome and reason code.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is routed to manual_review with reason code UNCLEAR.

test_cases.title: Route a claim above 1,000 and within its category limit for manual review
preconditions: The claim's category limit is greater than 1,000.
The claim is otherwise eligible for automatic approval.
steps: Submit a claim for 1,000.01.
Evaluate the claim's routing and recommendation.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is routed to manual_review with reason code HIGH_VALUE and is not recommended for automatic approval.

test_cases.title: Do not classify a claim of exactly 1,000 as high value
preconditions: The claim's category limit is greater than 1,000.
steps: Submit a claim for exactly 1,000.
Evaluate the claim's routing reason.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is not classified or routed as HIGH_VALUE.

test_cases.title: Use OVER_LIMIT when a claim exceeds both its category limit and 1,000
preconditions: The claim's category limit is 1,200.
steps: Submit a claim for 1,300.
Evaluate the claim's routing and reason code.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is routed with reason code OVER_LIMIT, not HIGH_VALUE, and is not recommended for automatic approval.

test_cases.title: Submit an appeal by replying to a declined-claim decision letter
preconditions: The member has received a decision letter declining a claim.
steps: Reply to the decision letter to submit an appeal.
State why the member believes the claim decision is wrong.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal is received and recorded against the declined claim with the member's reason for disputing the decision.

test_cases.title: Submit an appeal through the member portal
preconditions: The member can access the member portal.
The member has a claim that was declined.
steps: Open the declined claim in the member portal.
Choose the option to appeal the decision.
Enter why the member believes the decision is wrong.
Submit the appeal.
test_cases.expected_result: The portal accepts the appeal and records it against the declined claim, including the member's reason for disputing the decision.

test_cases.title: Include missing information with an appeal
preconditions: The member has a declined claim and is submitting an appeal.
steps: Provide a reason why the decision is wrong.
Include information missing from the original claim, such as a referral, pre-authorisation number, or provider description showing an injury was accidental.
Submit the appeal.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal records the member's reason and the additional information provided for review.

test_cases.title: Assign the appeal to a senior assessor not involved in the original decision
preconditions: A member has submitted an appeal against a declined claim.
The original decision and the assessor who made it are recorded.
steps: Route the appeal for review.
Check the role and prior involvement of the assigned reviewer.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal is reviewed by a senior claims assessor who was not involved in the original decision.

test_cases.title: Do not assign an appeal to the original decision-maker
preconditions: A member has submitted an appeal against a declined claim.
The original decision-maker is identifiable.
steps: Route the appeal for review when the original decision-maker is available.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal is assigned to a senior claims assessor other than the original decision-maker.

test_cases.title: Route dissatisfaction with service as a complaint
preconditions: The member has expressed dissatisfaction with the service received but is not disputing the claim decision.
steps: Submit the member's concern through the appeal channel.
Review how the concern is classified and routed.
test_cases.expected_result: The concern is handled as a complaint, not recorded or routed as an appeal.
